logline: 토끼를 쫓아 굴로 뛰어든 소녀가, 규칙이 전부 뒤집힌 나라를 지나간다.
destination: 하트 여왕의 정원 — 모든 길이 모이는 곳
protagonist: 금발에 파란 원피스, 흰 앞치마를 두른 일곱 살 소녀
setting: 빅토리아 시대 영국의 들판과 그 아래 이상한 나라
anchor: a seven-year-old girl with long blonde hair, blue dress and white pinafore
palette: storybook jewel tones, teal shadow, warm gold light, playing-card red

beats.beat: 소녀가 조끼 입은 토끼를 따라 달린다.
beats.visual: a girl in a blue dress running after a waistcoated white rabbit across a summer meadow
beats.motion: she runs after the rabbit toward the hedgerow, grass whips past, the rabbit bounds ahead

beats.beat: 소녀가 나무 밑 굴로 굴러 떨어진다.
beats.visual: a girl tumbling down a deep earthen shaft lined with floating cupboards and hanging lamps
beats.motion: she falls downward past the shelves, her skirt balloons up, jars turn around her

beats.beat: 소녀가 아주 작은 문 앞에 웅크린다.
beats.visual: a girl crouched before a tiny brass-handled door in a hall of many locked doors
beats.motion: she bends down toward the little door, curtains lift, keys swing on the wall

beats.visual: a girl grown enormous, head pressed to a ceiling, one arm out a window of a small hall
beats.motion: she stretches upward against the ceiling, furniture skids away, plaster dust falls

beats.visual: a large blue caterpillar on a spotted mushroom cap looking down at a small girl below
beats.motion: smoke rings drift up off the caterpillar, the mushroom sways, the girl tips her head back

beats.beat: 긴 탁자에서 모자 장수가 찻잔을 밀어 놓는다.
beats.visual: a wild-haired hatter at a long outdoor tea table shoving a teacup toward an empty chair
beats.motion: the cup skids down the table toward the chair, tea slops out, a dormouse tips over

beats.beat: 카드 병정들이 붉은 장미를 칠하다 멈춘다.
beats.visual: playing-card soldiers with paint buckets halted before a white rose bush, brushes dripping
beats.motion: the brushes stop mid-stroke, red paint drips down the petals, the cards straighten up

beats.beat: 빈 정원에 젖은 붓과 장미만 남는다.
beats.visual: an empty garden path with a dropped dripping brush beside half-painted roses, hedges beyond
beats.motion: paint drips off the brush into the gravel, rose heads nod, hedge shadows swing

withheld: 여왕의 재판에서 벌어지는 소동과, 소녀가 눈을 뜨는 마지막
